government.note: Parliamentary republic. The President is indirectly elected by the House of Representatives for a five-year, non-renewable term and has no legislative veto; the President dissolves the House at the Prime Minister's request or after a successful no-confidence motion. The Prime Minister leads the party with a majority in the unicameral House of Representatives.

holders.note: Inaugurated on 4 April 2024; term ends on 4 April 2029 according to the Wikipedia list.

offices.note: Presidents are appointed by resolution of the House of Representatives. These House votes (2004, 2009, 2014, 2019, 2024) are not recorded in elections.json because the sources fetched do not give the dates of the votes; the outcome is carried by this holder list. Short periods when an acting president stands in during the President's absence abroad are not listed by the sources used and are not recorded.

system.note: Single transferable vote with five members from each of thirteen districts (65 constituency seats). Extra at-large seats are added when needed so that the party with a majority of first-preference votes has a majority of seats, or to restore proportionality between the two parliamentary parties; a gender-corrective mechanism added twelve seats (six per party) in both 2022 and 2026. The House therefore varies in size (65 in 1998-2003, 69 in 2008 and 2013, 67 in 2017, 79 in 2022 and 2026); seats here is the 1998-2003 size. seats_2000 is the September 1998 result.
